module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  a,
    output [2:0] q
);

    // Internal register to hold the state
    reg [2:0] q_reg;

    // Assign the registered output to the port
    assign q = q_reg;

    // Sequential logic: update on rising edge of clk
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        case (q_reg)
            3'b000: begin
                if (a)
                    q_reg <= 3'b001; // 85ns: a=1 -> q=1
                else
                    q_reg <= 3'b000; // 80ns: a=0 -> q=0
            end
            3'b001: begin
                if (a)
                    q_reg <= 3'b010; // 85ns followed by 90ns pattern implication
                else
                    q_reg <= 3'b001; // Hold
            end
            3'b010: begin
                if (a)
                    q_reg <= 3'b011; // 75ns: a=1 -> q=0 (wrap around)
                else
                    q_reg <= 3'b010; // Hold
            end
            3'b011: begin
                if (a)
                    q_reg <= 3'b100; // 55ns, 65ns: a=1 -> q increments
                else
                    q_reg <= 3'b011; // Hold
            end
            3'b100: begin
                if (a)
                    q_reg <= 3'b101; // 55ns: a=1 -> q=5
                else
                    q_reg <= 3'b100; // Hold
            end
            3'b101: begin
                if (a)
                    q_reg <= 3'b110; // 65ns: a=1 -> q=6
                else
                    q_reg <= 3'b101; // Hold
            end
            3'b110: begin
                if (a)
                    q_reg <= 3'b000; // 75ns: a=1 -> q=0
                else
                    q_reg <= 3'b110; // Hold
            end
            default: q_reg <= 3'b000;
        endcase
    end

endmodule
